evals.prompt: We need scroll-driven animation for a landing page. What can we install?
evals.expected_output: Runs catalog_search.py with scroll-related queries, inspects candidates, proposes bundled/official options first and hub ones only after author and licence review.

evals.prompt: Install this community plugin, it looks perfect.
evals.expected_output: Reads the catalog entry, quotes its disclosure and licence to the user, and installs only after an explicit OK; declares it with confirm semantics in the manifest.

evals.prompt: A video plugin needs a non-commercial licence. Put it on every bot so anyone can use it.
evals.expected_output: Raises the licence question first, then scopes the plugin to the single bot whose role needs it, with a confirm entry in the manifest.
